aka.en: Carretera Constitución (the Piedras Negras–Monclova–Saltillo section, in Coahuila)
aka.zh: 宪法公路（科阿韦拉州境内彼德拉斯内格拉斯—蒙克洛瓦—萨尔蒂约段）

aka.en: Autopista México–Querétaro (the toll motorway at the southern end, 57D)
aka.zh: 墨西哥城—克雷塔罗高速公路（南端收费高速，57D）

tagline.en: A freight road to Texas whose southern end, the México–Querétaro motorway, records more crashes than any other in Mexico
tagline.zh: 通往得克萨斯的货运公路；其南端的墨西哥城—克雷塔罗高速是全国事故最多的高速公路

start.en: Mexico City's north-western edge, where the drawn line begins on the La Venta–Lechería road; the México–Querétaro motorway itself ends at the Periférico by Ciudad Satélite
start.zh: 墨西哥城西北边缘，图上线路始于拉本塔—莱切里亚公路；墨西哥城—克雷塔罗高速公路本身止于卫星城旁的环城公路（Periférico）

end.en: Piedras Negras, Coahuila, at the international bridge to Eagle Pass, Texas, where the road continues as US 57
end.zh: 科阿韦拉州彼德拉斯内格拉斯，经国际桥通往美国得克萨斯州伊格尔帕斯，过境后接美国 57 号公路

en: Federal Highway 57 leaves Mexico City north-west through Tlalnepantla, Cuautitlán Izcalli and Tepotzotlán, crosses a corner of Hidalgo at Tepeji del Río, and reaches Querétaro by way of San Juan del Río. From there it turns north over the plateau by San Luis de la Paz and San Luis Potosí to Matehuala, crosses southern Nuevo León by Puerto México and San Roberto, and enters Coahuila to run through Saltillo, Ramos Arizpe, Monclova, Sabinas, Nueva Rosita and Allende to the Rio Grande at Piedras Negras.

Its first 175 km are the toll motorway from Mexico City to Querétaro. Banobras, the state development bank that runs it, calls it one of the country's most important logistics corridors and counts it within the corridor from Mexico City to Nuevo Laredo with a branch to Piedras Negras, and says that corridor carries about 20 per cent of Mexico's road freight. A 2023 proposal in the Senate went further and repeated an estimate that half the goods traded between Mexico and the United States travel on Highway 57.
The length is given as 1,295 km in Spanish Wikipedia and the regional press, and as 1,301.83 km in English Wikipedia, which adds up the transport ministry's 2011 state traffic tables.
zh: 57 号联邦公路自墨西哥城向西北驶出，经特拉尔内潘特拉、夸乌蒂特兰伊斯卡利和特波索特兰，在特佩希德尔里奥穿过伊达尔戈州一角，经圣胡安德尔里奥抵达克雷塔罗。随后转向北方，越过高原，经圣路易斯德拉帕斯、圣路易斯波托西至马特瓦拉，经普埃尔托墨西哥和圣罗伯托穿过新莱昂州南部，进入科阿韦拉州，经萨尔蒂约、拉莫斯阿里斯佩、蒙克洛瓦、萨维纳斯、新罗西塔和阿连德，抵达彼德拉斯内格拉斯的格兰德河畔。
最初的 175 公里是墨西哥城至克雷塔罗的收费高速。经营这条路的国家开发银行 Banobras 称其为全国最重要的物流走廊之一，并将其列入“墨西哥城—新拉雷多（含彼德拉斯内格拉斯支线）”走廊，称该走廊承担全国约 20% 的公路货运。2023 年参议院的一份提案说得更远，转述了一项估计：墨美之间贸易的货物有一半走 57 号公路。
其长度在西班牙文维基百科和地方媒体中为 1,295 公里；英文维基百科按交通部 2011 年各州交通数据表累加，为 1,301.83 公里。

en: The northern end came first. A ministry history of 1975, quoted in the Coahuila press, records that the Piedras Negras–Monclova–Saltillo road, known as the Carretera Constitución, was paved between 1930 and 1940. At that time Coahuila's only road connection to the capital ran the long way round, through Monterrey, Ciudad Victoria, Ciudad Valles and Pachuca, on what is now Highway 85.

The direct line south was completed in the 1950s, when, in the same history's words, Highway 57 was finished with the section from Saltillo to Mexico City by way of Matehuala, San Luis Potosí and Querétaro. Local press dates the opening to October 1958, when President Adolfo Ruiz Cortines inaugurated the road at San Juan del Río; Spanish Wikipedia gives 1 November 1958. The federal projects register dates the start of operation of the México–Querétaro toll motorway to 1 October 1958, so the 1958 ceremony may belong to that piece rather than the whole route; the sources read do not say.

The road has a reputation to match its traffic. The public broadcaster IMER's news service writes that lorry hijackings, kidnapping reports and operations against organised crime in 2008 and 2009 made the 57 notorious as unsafe; a lorry driver it interviewed described a kidnapping in Matehuala and a trailer stolen in San Luis Potosí, and insecurity on the Nuevo León and Coahuila stretches. On the motorway the danger is collisions: a 2023 Senate proposal, citing the Mexican Transport Institute, calls México–Querétaro the motorway with the most incidents in the country, and the yearbook of crashes on federal roads recorded 434 on México–Querétaro in 2021, with 77 dead and 134 injured, 83 per cent of the crashes in the state of Querétaro.
zh: 北端最先建成。交通部 1975 年的一部史志（科阿韦拉报刊曾加以引述）记载，彼德拉斯内格拉斯—蒙克洛瓦—萨尔蒂约公路，即“宪法公路”，于 1930 至 1940 年间铺装。当时科阿韦拉通往首都的唯一公路要绕远路，经蒙特雷、维多利亚城、巴耶斯城和帕丘卡——也就是今天的 85 号公路。

直通南方的线路于 1950 年代建成。用同一部史志的话说，57 号公路以萨尔蒂约经马特瓦拉、圣路易斯波托西和克雷塔罗至墨西哥城一段的完工而告建成。地方媒体称，1958 年 10 月阿道弗·鲁伊斯·科蒂内斯总统在圣胡安德尔里奥为该路揭幕；西班牙文维基百科作 1958 年 11 月 1 日。联邦项目登记把墨西哥城—克雷塔罗收费高速的启用日期记为 1958 年 10 月 1 日，因此 1958 年的仪式可能属于这一段而非全线；所查资料并未说明。

这条路的名声与它的车流相称。公共广播机构 IMER 的新闻台写道，2008 至 2009 年间，劫持货车、绑架报案与打击有组织犯罪的行动让 57 号路以不安全著称；该台采访的一名货车司机讲述了马特瓦拉的一起绑架、圣路易斯波托西的一次挂车被盗，以及新莱昂和科阿韦拉路段的不安全。在高速段，危险来自碰撞：2023 年一份参议院提案援引墨西哥交通研究所的数据，称墨西哥城—克雷塔罗是全国事故最多的高速公路；联邦公路事故年鉴记录，2021 年墨西哥城—克雷塔罗高速共发生 434 起事故，77 人死亡、134 人受伤，其中 83% 发生在克雷塔罗州境内。

en: The México–Querétaro motorway is six lanes, three each way, widening to eight between kilometres 166 and 176 at San Juan del Río; Spanish Wikipedia calls it the motorway with the most lanes in Mexico. It has two runaway-lorry ramps on the northbound carriageway, at kilometres 158 and 160, and connects with the Arco Norte and the Circuito Exterior Mexiquense in the State of Mexico.
zh: 墨西哥城—克雷塔罗高速为双向六车道，在圣胡安德尔里奥的 166 至 176 公里处拓宽为八车道；西班牙文维基百科称它是墨西哥车道最多的高速公路。北行方向在 158 公里和 160 公里处设有两条货车紧急避险车道；该路在墨西哥州与北弧线（Arco Norte）和墨西哥州外环（Circuito Exterior Mexiquense）相连。

en: No construction cost for the route has been published. The toll motorway has been held since 30 September 2011 under a sixty-year concession by Fonadin, the national infrastructure fund administered by Banobras, which pays for its operation and upkeep from tolls; the concession runs to 30 September 2071.

The fund is now widening it. In July 2026 Banobras let contracts worth 586.36 million pesos for the Tepotzotlán–Jorobas stretch, kilometres 43.1 to 52.8, which it said was already at or beyond capacity, with work due to start on 17 August 2026 and last a year. Separately, on 4 March 2026 President Claudia Sheinbaum announced the widening of the Tepalcapa–Tepotzotlán stretch from ten to twelve lanes, put at more than 15,000 million pesos over up to thirty months.
zh: 全线没有公开的建设造价。收费高速自 2011 年 9 月 30 日起由 Banobras 管理的国家基础设施基金（Fonadin）以六十年特许经营，以通行费支付运营与养护，特许期至 2071 年 9 月 30 日。
该基金目前正在拓宽这条路。2026 年 7 月，Banobras 就特波索特兰—霍罗巴斯段（43.1 至 52.8 公里）签订合同共 5.8636 亿比索，称该段已达到或超出通行能力，工程定于 2026 年 8 月 17 日开工，工期一年。另外，2026 年 3 月 4 日，克劳迪娅·辛鲍姆总统宣布将特帕尔卡帕—特波索特兰段由十车道拓宽为十二车道，投资逾 150 亿比索，工期最长三十个月。

en: The motorway has two toll plazas, at kilometre 43 in Tepotzotlán and at kilometre 147; in January 2025 each charged a car 108 pesos and a motorcycle 54. The limit is 110 km/h, falling to 90 or 80 in places and usually 80 in the metropolitan area. Beside the free road runs the tolled 57D as the alternative; a 2022 article in the San Luis Potosí press put it at 342 km of four-lane road.
In San Luis Potosí and Querétaro the road is local shorthand as much as a highway: the football match between the two cities' clubs is called “el de la 57”.
zh: 高速设有两个收费站，分别在特波索特兰的 43 公里处和 147 公里处；2025 年 1 月，每站收取小汽车 108 比索、摩托车 54 比索。限速每小时 110 公里，部分路段降至 90 或 80 公里，都市区内通常为 80 公里。免费路之外另有收费的 57D 作为替代线；圣路易斯波托西媒体 2022 年的一篇报道称其为 342 公里的四车道道路。
在圣路易斯波托西和克雷塔罗，这条路不只是公路，也是当地的口头禅：两市俱乐部之间的足球赛被称为“57 号路德比”（el de la 57）。

value.en: 1,295 km in Spanish Wikipedia and the regional press; 1,301.83 km in English Wikipedia, summed from the 2011 Datos Viales
value.zh: 西班牙文维基百科及地方媒体作 1,295 公里；英文维基百科按 2011 年《道路数据》累加为 1,301.83 公里

figures.source: Spanish Wikipedia, Carretera Federal 57; La Orquesta (San Luis Potosí), 8 December 2022; SCT Datos Viales 2011, as cited in English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 57

label.zh: 墨西哥城—克雷塔罗高速

value.en: 174.472 km in the concession register (175.454 km in Spanish Wikipedia), six lanes, eight at San Juan del Río; operating since 1 October 1958
value.zh: 特许登记长 174.472 公里（西班牙文维基百科作 175.454 公里），六车道，圣胡安德尔里奥段八车道；1958 年 10 月 1 日起运营

figures.source: Proyectos México, project 0350 Carretera México-Querétaro; Spanish Wikipedia, Autopista México-Querétaro

value.en: Banobras estimated 127,900 vehicles a day in both directions in 2025 on the Tepotzotlán–Jorobas stretch, 17 per cent buses and lorries. Press figures for the motorway are higher and differ: “more than 204,000” (Milenio) and “around 210,000” (Xataka), without a stated count point.
value.zh: Banobras 估计 2025 年特波索特兰—霍罗巴斯段双向日均 127,900 辆，其中 17% 为客车和货车。媒体报道的数字更高且彼此不一：“逾 20.4 万辆”（Milenio）、“约 21 万辆”（Xataka），均未说明计数地点。

figures.source: Banobras, as reported by Quadratín Estado de México, 30 July 2026; Milenio and Xataka México, 2026

value.en: About 20 per cent of Mexico's road freight on the Mexico City–Nuevo Laredo corridor with its Piedras Negras branch (Banobras). A 2023 Senate proposal repeats an estimate of 50 per cent of Mexico–US traded goods on Highway 57; its basis is not given.
value.zh: Banobras 称，“墨西哥城—新拉雷多（含彼德拉斯内格拉斯支线）”走廊承担全国约 20% 的公路货运。2023 年一份参议院提案转述了墨美贸易货物 50% 走 57 号公路的估计，未说明依据。

figures.source: Banobras, as reported by Quadratín Estado de México, 30 July 2026; Senate point of agreement, “La carretera federal 57: una de las más peligrosas del país”, August 2023

value.en: 434 collisions on the México–Querétaro motorway, 77 killed and 134 injured; 364 of the collisions in the state of Querétaro
value.zh: 墨西哥城—克雷塔罗高速发生碰撞事故 434 起，77 人死亡、134 人受伤；其中 364 起在克雷塔罗州境内

figures.source: Instituto Mexicano del Transporte, Anuario Estadístico de Colisiones en Carreteras Federales 2021, as cited in a Senate point of agreement, August 2023

why.en: No figure has been published for the route. It was built in stages, the Coahuila end paved in the 1930s and the line from Saltillo to Mexico City finished in the 1950s, and the sources read give no cost for either; the 2026 widening contracts are in the Funding figure.
why.zh: 全线无公开数据。该路分期修建：科阿韦拉一端于 1930 年代铺装，萨尔蒂约至墨西哥城一段于 1950 年代完成，所查资料均未给出造价；2026 年的拓宽合同见“出资方”一项。

value.en: The free road is federal. The México–Querétaro motorway is held by Fonadin, the national infrastructure fund run by Banobras, under a sixty-year concession signed on 30 September 2011, paid from tolls. Its 2026 widening is financed through Fonadin: 573.78 million pesos of works and 12.58 million of supervision on Tepotzotlán–Jorobas.
value.zh: 免费路由联邦出资。墨西哥城—克雷塔罗高速由 Banobras 管理的国家基础设施基金（Fonadin）依据 2011 年 9 月 30 日签订的六十年特许持有，以通行费偿付。2026 年的拓宽经由 Fonadin 出资：特波索特兰—霍罗巴斯段工程 5.7378 亿比索、监理 1,258 万比索。

figures.source: Proyectos México, project 0350; Quadratín Estado de México, 30 July 2026; El Universal, 2026

timeline.en: The México–Querétaro toll motorway begins operating on 1 October; President Adolfo Ruiz Cortines inaugurates the road at San Juan del Río.
timeline.zh: 10 月 1 日，墨西哥城—克雷塔罗收费高速开始运营；阿道弗·鲁伊斯·科蒂内斯总统在圣胡安德尔里奥为该路揭幕。

timeline.en: On 30 September the motorway is placed under a sixty-year concession to Fonadin.
timeline.zh: 9 月 30 日，该高速以六十年特许交由国家基础设施基金（Fonadin）经营。
墨西哥城—克雷塔罗高速发生 434 起碰撞事故，77 人死亡。

timeline.en: A Senate proposal in August calls on the transport ministry, CAPUFE and the National Guard to improve safety on the México–Querétaro section.
timeline.zh: 8 月，参议院一份提案敦促交通部、联邦公路桥梁公司（CAPUFE）和国民警卫队改善墨西哥城—克雷塔罗段的交通安全。

timeline.en: Each motorway toll plaza charges a car 108 pesos from January.
timeline.zh: 1 月起，高速每个收费站对小汽车收费 108 比索。

timeline.en: The ten-to-twelve-lane widening of Tepalcapa–Tepotzotlán is announced on 4 March; work on Tepotzotlán–Jorobas is scheduled to start on 17 August.
timeline.zh: 3 月 4 日，宣布特帕尔卡帕—特波索特兰段由十车道拓宽为十二车道；特波索特兰—霍罗巴斯段工程定于 8 月 17 日开工。
